scope: Authorized disposable resize startup attempts; none reached a native setter or pixel proof.
findings: First attempt refused preflight before spawning a fixture.

Second attempt created the owned fixture but failed identity/AX/transform enrollment. The fixture frame remained original, transform equality failed, and its interruption guard suppressed restoration. Controller and fixture exited; external cleanup check proved fixture process/windows gone. Combined diagnostics do not establish a human cause.

Noninteractive attempt preserved foreground and input exclusion in both processes. Independent AX/CG geometry agreed at 440x280. Ready was published before CG registration, with an identity transform; the registered transform then differed and the fixture exited before SCK discovery. No native setter or screenshots; fixture process/windows independently absent.

Registered baseline barrier succeeded after 49ms; AX/CG geometry, exact SCK window and foreground checks passed. Before initial capture, controller input isolation rejected MouseEntered (type8), and fixture window-exclusion checks failed without a reported input/foreground/geometry/transform change. No setter or pixels; fixture process/windows independently absent. Per-window diagnostics are needed to identify the exclusion failure.

Passive tracking no longer interrupts the controller. Fixture exclusion fails on exact class NSLocalWindowSharingWindow, window_id -1, invisible, not key/main and unable to become key/main; source/decoy geometry and transforms remain unchanged. No setter/pixels; fixture process/windows independently absent. Narrow inert-helper handling is under review.

Exact hidden sharing helper was accepted before registration, then received window ID 80213 while remaining invisible and unable to become key/main. The guard rejected this registration transition. Original fixture/decoy geometry and transforms remained unchanged, no actionable input or foreground change occurred, and no setter or pixels were reached. Fixture process/windows independently absent.

Hidden-helper validation passed. Initial source capture settled and before.png shows the fixture through both canvas views. The resize gesture did not begin because logical source focus was absent; no setter ran. Independent restoration/cleanup checks passed. The PNG carries a display ICC profile rather than the sRGB byte contract expected by the independent oracle; no pixel-proof success is claimed.

With logical focus preparation, startup was interrupted before the first screenshot: hidden sharing helper ID80648 had no observable CG row; all its AppKit visibility/focus flags remained inert. A later controller MouseMoved event was also rejected. No native setter or pixel proof; original fixture/decoy geometry unchanged and fixture process/windows independently absent.
